name: Apex Dynamics, Inc.
summary: Apex Dynamics, Inc. engages in the production and sale of robots for plastics injection molding machines in Taiwan, Asia, the Americas, Europe, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Precision Machinery and Food and Beverage Services Unit. It offers mechanical transmission components, including gearbox, rack and pinion, coupling, and smart lubrication; precision reducers; and automatic control equipment. It is also involved in the hotel accommodation service and food and beverages business. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Taichung, Taiwan.
